acceptanceCriteria: With an injected short sequence deadline (test seam), reproduce the misleading codes or refute with counts.
If reproduced: expiry maps to one documented deadline/cancellation refusal code in every expand path, with a test per path and one mutation; the governing spec row names the code.
body: suspected: Residual from the V1-0969/V1-1398 cmd/corvint flakes lane (PR #921, branch claude/cmd-flakes-0969-1398, head 38668fbc9, base 55b0c0f09; darwin go1.27.2, 12 cores). Under mutant M2 (no test lift of expandContextHandle's sequence bound, sourceDeadline(ctx), 10 s in production) at load 46-80, deadline expiry partway through `corvint context --expand` produced refusal codes that do not name the cause: a huge-range request answered missing-handle or expand-budget where invalid-handle was expected, and git-failed/non-utf8-source appeared on expiry. The read still refuses whole (no partial output). Expected: a deadline expiry yields a deadline/cancellation code (or the documented code), never an unrelated validation code.
title: suspected: context --expand reports misleading refusal codes when the sequence deadline expires mid-expansion
